outcomes.statement: Design grammars and automata for regular languages using the knowledge of grammars, languages, and automata
Identify the steps involved in lexical analyzer generators by familiarizing the different phases of a compiler
Evaluate the top-down and bottom-up parsing techniques by comparing their effectiveness in various computational contexts
Analyze expressions to generate appropriate three address code
Apply automated tools such as FLEX and YACC for lexical analysis and parser generation
